nodes.text: Pochettino toggles a 3-4-2-1 / 3-2-5-in-possession with a 4-4-2 or 5-3-2 mid-block out of possession — the group turns on whether the shape is opponent-specific enough to stay solid AND create.

nodes.storyline: The defensive spine under host pressure
nodes.text: Richards + Ream + Adams must control chaos in an even group; their experience and durability are the steadying factor.

nodes.storyline: Pulisic's 'legacy World Cup' — or a too-predictable attack
nodes.text: If Pulisic leads and the attack varies, the US advance comfortably; if it becomes predictable against compact blocks, it tightens.
Three effectively-home games (LA/Seattle) can lift the US — or make them play tense in a must-deliver group.
Paraguay sit in a compact 4-4-2 and counter — the US risk getting hit in transition if they over-commit.

nodes.storyline: Türkiye's fluid rotations in a high-stakes finale
nodes.text: Türkiye's rotating front and likely must-win final match could drag the US around if the group is still alive.
